summary: Roads, geography, seams, and ten-chain topology pass, but the mountain marks are scenic triangular side faces with connected hatching and therefore fail the golden plan-view gate.
required_changes: Replace only the ten scenic ridge drawings with 40±3 px low-contrast irregular parchment bands containing discontinuous crest fragments and one fully detached short hatch per band; preserve every other output pixel.
